_why: PLUGINRESERVE1 (D64 rule 3; .claude/knowledge/twins.md): the harness names this build runs, which no plugin may declare, one table both twins are held to. Every name either side runs as a harness is reserved, so no plugin's harness can shadow a built-in one: each door the driver's built set carries (AdapterSet.Built()), each agent a door runs as that has no door of its own (its holders: `codex` since CODEXACCT1, whose sign-in and status question a plugin named `codex` would otherwise take over), and each key of the CLI's TOOLCHAINS with the two gate stubs. `reserved` is the list, in ordinal order: the CLI's reservedHarnesses() and the driver's AdapterSet.Built().Reserved and PluginCatalog.Reserved are each held to it exactly. `declares`: why, a plugin's harness name, and whether each catalogue refuses the plugin for it as one this build carries, compared without case. A name added on one side alone fails that side's test.
declares: a gate stub, which no toolchain declares
an agent a door runs as, with no door of its own
a reserved name in any case
a name beside a reserved one
